title: RecallIndex
description: Deterministic Historical Addressing Layer — IPCF-1.1 recall index. Nodes are keyed by string step_id for O(1) lookup.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this index was first created.

nodes.description: Map of step_id (string key) → node metadata. Dict keyed by string step_id for O(1) lookup.

step_id.description: Canonical turn index sourced from conversation history.

summary.description: Human-readable summary of the folded turn.

payload_sha256.description: SHA-256 of raw source content before folding (CONF-02: immutable content identity).

projection_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical projection fields (CONF-11: deterministic logical identity).

artifact_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the serialized cold node file on disk (CONF-09: tamper detection).

file_path.description: POSIX relative disk path to the cold storage payload file.

token_estimate.description: Rough token count estimate for the archived content.

folded_at.description: UTC timestamp when this node was folded.

identifiers.description: Sorted, deduplicated searchable tokens extracted from summary and raw_content.

evicted.description: True if this node has been evicted from the active prompt after rehydration (CONF-07).
